sentences.en: He is so slothful that he never gets anything done.
sentences.zh: 他太懒惰了，什么也做不成。

sentences.en: The company's management team has become quite slothful over the years.
sentences.zh: 公司的管理层多年来变得相当懒散。

sentences.en: Don't be so slothful; let’s go for a jog together.
sentences.zh: 别这么懒惰了，我们一起去跑步吧。
